name: BSP_UnitBot_RequestLoadLevels
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet unit_command_producers, read-only analysis. void __thiscall(this, float dt), RET 4 (009F4D04), body 009F3F80-009F4D06, caller 009F4DA0, unit at this+3FCh. Raises the unit's two load latches six times: 009F438C and 009F4AB4 to computed levels, 009F4606 and 009F462A to 1.5f (00CE380C), 009F4912 when +1034h is below 1.5 (00CE3D78) and 009F4A51 when +102Ch is below 0.5 (00D7A280) to 0.5f (00CE3800). Each site is the inlined form of 009D4FB0/009D4FE0, a per-frame maximum latch; 009F45F8..009F4606 was confirmed against the listing. This resolves the open producer of unit+102Ch and +1034h that docs/UNIT_FORCE_COMMANDS.md recorded as reader-only. See docs/UNIT_COMMAND_PRODUCERS.md.
